diagram.manim_description: On a plain BG canvas of 1920 x 1080 px draw one horizontal row of 15 round tokens that touch each other like beads on a string, all the same size (diameter 112 px), all centred on the line y = 540 px; the centre of token 1 is at x = 116 px and every next centre is 112 px further right (token 15 is centred at x = 1684 px). Every token has a 3 px INK outline. Left to right: tokens 1, 2, 3 are positive (fill MARK_FILL, sign +); tokens 4, 5 are negative (fill SET_B, sign minus); tokens 6, 7, 8 are positive; tokens 9, 10 are negative; tokens 11, 12, 13 are positive; tokens 14, 15 are negative. Each sign is drawn in INK, centred in its token, about 64 px high (plus for positive, minus for negative). From the right edge of token 15 (x = 1740 px, y = 540 px) draw a thin INK wavy line, 3 px stroke, running right to x = 1860 px and curling down at its right end to y = 640 px, to show that the string goes on beyond the picture. Draw nothing else: no numbers, no brackets, no labels, no struck-out token.
